source_en: Papers. Diko Kozlov. Coal Face B, east shaft. Thirty years.
I know I'm dirty. Showers at the shaft are out three days.
Under it. The air tastes like pennies down there now. We keep digging.
...Every miner coughs. Mine's no worse. Maybe a little.
Eleven hours today. I don't complain.
My wife. The coal. I don't know anything else.
Nobody, since the foreman went up the east road. We run ourselves now.
